node.statement: Write Z in M_{2n} tensor S_P as a 2-by-2 block matrix (Z_ij). Ruan compression gives ||Z_ij||<=||Z|| and the 2-by-2 operator-matrix bound gives ||Z||<=2 max_ij||Z_ij||. Since h_{2n}(Z)=(h_n(Z_ij)) entrywise and target-block compression is contractive, ||h_{2n}(Z)||>=max_ij||h_n(Z_ij)||>=a_n max_ij||Z_ij||>=a_n||Z||/2; hence a_{2n}>=a_n/2.
